description: Dated log of what changed in this data, newest first: changed visa minimums, fees, processing times and years to residency or citizenship (changed, with from and to), countries added to or taken off tax blacklists (listed, delisted), and programs or details MyLatinLife added to its coverage (coverage_added, detail_added, coverage_removed). Dates are when MyLatinLife recorded the change, not when a law took effect.

country.description: Only changes for this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

kind.description: Only this kind of change. "changed" is a value that changed; the coverage kinds track what MyLatinLife covers.

limit.description: How many changes to return, newest first. Defaults to 20.

since.description: Only changes recorded on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

topic.description: Only changes in this topic. Dataset topic, e.g. "tax_systems", "digital_nomad_visas" or "cost_of_living".

name: get_recent_changes
title: Recent changes
